title: SoccerTraining
description: SoccerTraining helps football players improve through structured video sessions for passing, shooting, dribbling, and fitness. A custom JSON database organizes video titles and YouTube links for fast, intuitive navigation.

title: NurHub
description: NurHub supports Muslims in their daily religious practice with prayer times, prayer guidance, Quran and Hadith access online and offline, Tafsir, a Tasbih counter, and a Hijri calendar.

title: PSDonation
description: PSDonation raises awareness and supports donations for Palestinians through historical information, an interactive map, and curated verified donation links.

title: SoundBoardMobile
description: SoundBoardMobile is a fun, lightweight application with multiple soundboards organized into categories for quick, simple entertainment.

title: Trading App
description: TradingForAhmed is a personalized trading application that tracks stocks and currencies in real time through a freemium API and provides basic market-analysis features.

title: BooksReader
description: BooksReader organizes large PDF collections by automatically extracting metadata and covers. It supports local and website imports, plus AI-powered text-to-speech and translation through Python and Chaquopy.

title: Ma7leek
description: Ma7leek is a fully functional e-commerce clothing platform with user accounts, a loyalty and reward system, product customization through an integrated designer, and dynamic discount logic.

title: ATLAS - WORLD MAP
description: World-Map is an interactive vibe-coded web application that displays all countries on a global map. Clicking a country reveals detailed information.

title: Club Privileges API Exposure
description: I identified a Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) vulnerability in Club Privileges' email-viewing API. By knowing or enumerating a sequential ticket ID, an unauthenticated user could access the email address associated with any customer record, including past and future records. I responsibly reported the issue to the technical support team, and they resolved it.
